tools.name: check_conditions
tools.description: Check live safety conditions at a coordinate on US public land: active wildfire perimeters and distance to the nearest fire, river and streamflow level against seasonal normals, advisory-grade weather in the next 7 days, open park closures and hazard alerts, and air quality. Returns a 0-100 Trip Saf

tools.name: find_campgrounds
tools.description: Find campgrounds within a radius of a coordinate across federal, state and private land, with whether each is reservable and a booking link. Call this when someone asks where to camp near a place. Returns the campground's own page so conditions and site detail can be read next.

tools.name: find_trails
tools.description: Find named hiking trails within a radius of a coordinate, ranked by how much is known about each rather than by raw length, so service roads and sidewalks do not lead the list. Returns distance, elevation gain, and route shape where known. Call this when someone asks what to hike near a place.

findings.title: Description uses pressure/override language
findings.detail: Description of "check_conditions" stacks urgency/override words (never, warning). Legitimate tool descriptions rarely pressure the model to act or ignore prior guidance.
